name: Musée Cernuschi
description: museum of Asian art in Paris, France

summary.text: The Musée Cernuschi, officially also the Musée des arts de l'Asie de la Ville de Paris, is an Asian art museum located at 7 avenue Vélasquez, near Parc Monceau, in Paris, France. Its Asian art collection is second in Paris only to that of the Musée Guimet.
summary.title: Musée Cernuschi
